name: OpenAI Backend
description: OpenAI backend for Level 3 translation and calibration. Provides a wrapper around the OpenAI API for chat completions with lazy client initialization and environment-based configuration.

types.name: OpenAIBackend

fields.name: _api_key
fields.description: OpenAI API key (may be empty string)

types.description: Backend implementation for OpenAI chat completions API with lazy client initialization.

functions.name: __init__
functions.description: Initialize the OpenAI backend with optional API key and model. Falls back to environment variables OPENAI_API_KEY and TRANSMOG_MODEL, with gpt-4o-mini as the default model.

inputs.name: api_key
inputs.description: OpenAI API key. If None, reads from OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: OpenAI model identifier. If None, reads from TRANSMOG_MODEL environment variable or defaults to gpt-4o-mini.

postconditions: self._api_key is set to provided api_key or OPENAI_API_KEY environment variable or empty string
self._model is set to provided model or TRANSMOG_MODEL environment variable or 'gpt-4o-mini'
self._client is set to None (lazy initialization)
side_effects: Reads environment variables OPENAI_API_KEY and TRANSMOG_MODEL

functions.name: _ensure_client
functions.description: Lazily initialize the OpenAI client if not already created. Imports openai module and creates client with stored API key.

error_cases.name: authentication_error
error_cases.condition: Invalid API key provided to openai.OpenAI constructor

postconditions: self._client is an instance of openai.OpenAI if it was None
self._client remains unchanged if already initialized

functions.name: complete
functions.description: Generate a chat completion using the OpenAI API. Prepends system message if provided, then sends all messages to the configured model with temperature=0 for deterministic output.

inputs.name: system
inputs.description: System message content. If empty/falsy, no system message is added.

inputs.name: messages
inputs.description: List of message dictionaries with 'role' and 'content' keys

inputs.name: max_tokens
inputs.description: Maximum tokens in the completion response

error_cases.name: api_error
error_cases.condition: OpenAI API returns an error (rate limit, invalid model, etc.)

preconditions: messages must be a list of dicts compatible with OpenAI chat API format
postconditions: Returns the content of the first choice from the API response
self._client is initialized after call completes
side_effects: Calls _ensure_client which may import openai and create client
Makes HTTP request to OpenAI API

structured_side_effects.description: HTTP POST to OpenAI API endpoint

performance_budget.complexity: O(n) where n is total message content length

invariants: Default model is 'gpt-4o-mini' when not specified
Temperature is always 0 for deterministic completions
Client is lazily initialized on first complete() call

data_access.rationale: Backend wrapper that reads configuration from environment and makes external API calls to OpenAI

side_effects.rationale: Makes HTTP requests to OpenAI API for chat completions
Reads environment variables for API key and model configuration during initialization
